exposure: Care bundles involving eight protocolized interventions
cohort: The study included 2,125 very low birth weight (VLBW) infants admitted to a Level III C neonatal intensive care unit (NICU) between 2011 and 2021.
finding: A multipronged quality improvement approach, including an evidence-based SIVH prevention bundle and RC-PC-S analysis, was associated with a sustained significant reduction in the rate of severe intraventricular hemorrhage in VLBW infants.
